# KeepDB

> Structured memory for AI agents, and a quick database for everything else.

KeepDB lets developers save feedback, waitlist signups, notes, prompts, logs,
links, and agent memory into folders. The same data can be searched from the
dashboard, API, or agents.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://keepdb.dev): Product overview and private access signup.
- [Docs](https://keepdb.dev/docs): REST API examples for saving and searching memory.
- [Agents](https://keepdb.dev/agents): Copy-paste instructions for AI agents.
- [Use cases](https://keepdb.dev/use-cases): Common ways to use KeepDB.

## Use Cases

- [Agent memory](https://keepdb.dev/use-cases/agent-memory): Shared memory for AI agents and coding agents.
- [Customer feedback database](https://keepdb.dev/use-cases/customer-feedback): Store and search feedback, support notes, and bug reports.
- [Quick database](https://keepdb.dev/use-cases/quick-database): A simple place for waitlists, logs, links, notes, and side data.
- [Prompt library](https://keepdb.dev/use-cases/prompt-library): Store reusable prompts and agent instructions.

## API and MCP

Base URL: `https://api.keepdb.dev`
MCP URL: `https://mcp.keepdb.dev/mcp`

Main endpoints:

- `POST /memory`: Save one memory into a folder.
- `GET /memory`: Search globally or inside a folder.
- `GET /collections/:name/memories`: List memories in one folder.
- `DELETE /memory/:memoryId`: Soft delete a memory.

Authentication uses bearer API keys. API keys can be global or folder-scoped,
and can be read-only, write-only, or read + write.

Claude Code MCP setup:

```bash
claude mcp add --transport http keepdb https://mcp.keepdb.dev/mcp \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer keep_sk_your_api_key"
```
